reserveReview.rationale: Re-checked 2026-08-29: the current Solomon protocol-data API is updated 2026-08-29 and marked valid for 2026-08-28. It reports protocolTvl $1,514,736.25, Ceffu custody of BTC $362,439.43 and SOL $2,602.41, on-chain vault USDC $83,957.34 and USDT $17,521.46, and no yield-distributor or reserve-fund balance. The identified physical reserve components total $466,520.64, or 30.7988% of protocolTvl; the remaining 69.2012% has no issuer-explained allocation. Binance inverse-perpetual notionals are hedge positions, not additive reserve assets, so they are not counted as backing. The latest public Ceffu attestation remains dated 2026-04-01 and does not provide a current itemized reconciliation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Solomon current protocol-data API reserve components measured against protocolTvl $1,514,736.25 at the 2026-08-28 validity point; Ceffu custody and hedge fields retained without double-counting hedge notionals
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: About 69.2% of protocolTvl has no issuer-explained backing allocation in the current API. The API does not reconcile reserve components to protocolTvl; the location and segregation of margin supporting Binance hedge positions is undisclosed. The latest public Ceffu attestation remains dated 2026-04-01 and is aggregate rather than a current independent audit.
